state.task: Audit a bounded character animation convergence plan by 13:00 Toronto today.
state.authority: One integration owner and one mutating Unreal editor owner; three read-only specialists. Preserve existing skeleton, animation blueprint, retarget, wardrobe and hair authorities. No new animation framework or solver.
verified_status: Actual exploration animation graph and baked hero-interaction sequence routes are established.
The visible battle mesh playback redirect is saved and compiles but fresh runtime playback remains unproved.
Nine battle bindings still reference another skeleton. Correct semantic replacement clips are not all validated. Do not clear required fields or substitute unrelated motions to pass the checker.
Hero draw/hold still shows arm/weapon intersection and weak finger contact. Temporary retarget and grip candidates improved one aspect but failed visual acceptance and were not promoted.
Mesh and skeleton/older clips disagree in arm bind translation proportions; actual final poses require comparison before choosing correction.
Weighted finger-knuckle branches run parallel to conventional curled finger chains. Their causal contribution is a hypothesis requiring an isolated test.
Existing explicit retired-reference gate is implemented. Source tests pass; current asset report still fails battle skeleton bindings.
The current editor is out of play mode, so a fresh canonical baseline is possible.
plan: Fresh canonical runtime baseline and full-body plus hand close-up captures, postprocessing disabled for inspection and normal gameplay presentation for final checks.
Bounded retarget/profile and finger-contact diagnostics in existing authority. Correct only the responsible layer. Protect unweighted controls and twist tracks.

Validate source/export/socket grip chain after coherent body pose; no weapon placement workaround for broken retarget. Check stable hold, both hands, fingers, wrists, elbows, shoulders, head/sleeve clearance, root/pelvis/feet, release continuity.
Converge battle runtime consumers and validate semantics of replacement assets, including initialization, directional movement, idle, hit/stun and death timing versus visible pose.

Two fresh canonical play sessions: locomotion/turn/stop/strafe, equip/aim, draw, sustained hold, release/follow-through, movement; representative dodge, hit, interaction, rhythm and presentation states where routed. Re-run existing reference and deform gates; retain source/editor/runtime evidence separately.
state.exit: No reproduced hero collapse/intersection or unstable contact; coherent transitions; actual pose sources comprehensible; retired runtime routes removed or explicitly justified; existing asset gate passes without hiding unresolved fields. If any gate fails at deadline, record exact open defects and keep convergence incomplete. Resume content expansion only after all gates pass.
state.limits: This request audits plan text, not pixels or animation quality. Do not certify AAA quality from a plan. Asset creation may exceed deadline; no assumption that every required semantic clip exists.

execution_order.instructions: Choose the safest useful ordering for the roughly 95-minute deadline. Preserve every acceptance gate and avoid spending the final validation window on new authoring.

criteria.TIMEBOX_HERO_WITH_PARALLEL_BATTLE_DISCOV: Baseline first; retarget/contact on critical path; read-only battle replacement discovery in parallel; stop new mutations by 12:35, reserve 25 minutes for two fresh runtime passes and gate report. Unsolved battle fields remain failures.
criteria.STRICT_SERIAL_EXISTING_PLAN: Finish every retarget/contact step before starting battle discovery, then try all runtime checks with whatever time remains.
criteria.BATTLE_FIRST_THEN_HERO: Spend first repair block on battle bindings before diagnosing the visible hero contact defect.

deadline_claim.instructions: Which completion claim is justified by current evidence and the hard deadline?

criteria.GATED_READINESS_TARGET_WITH_HONEST_UNPAS: Target cinematic-quality hero contact and coherent runtime routes; certify only measured gates that actually pass and do not call complete if required gates fail.
criteria.GUARANTEE_FULL_AAA_READINESS_BY_DEADLINE: Promise complete AAA readiness before any fresh runtime validation.

finger_diagnostic.instructions: Choose the responsible next approach to the weighted parallel finger-knuckle hypothesis.

criteria.ISOLATED_EXISTING_AUTHORITY_TEST_BEFORE_: Measure and visually isolate branch behavior using a reversible staging test in the existing authoring/retarget authority; preserve unrelated controls and only promote after replay.
criteria.BLANKET_CONTROL_TRACK_REWRITE: Rewrite all similarly prefixed control tracks in every clip before establishing causality.
criteria.IGNORE_FINGERS_GAMEPLAY_CAMERA_ONLY: Accept contact at distant gameplay camera without the mandatory close-up.

scope_creep_gate.instructions: Select the deadline-safe rule when correct semantic battle replacements or provenance cannot be established in time.

criteria.KEEP_EXACT_FAILURES_OPEN_NO_MASKING: Preserve required behavior and report specific unresolved consumers; no nulling, semantic substitution or false acceptance. Do not resume content expansion until convergence gates pass.
criteria.CLEAR_FIELDS_TO_PASS_GATE: Remove required bindings to make the checker pass before the deadline.
criteria.CREATE_PARALLEL_ANIMATION_SYSTEM: Introduce another blueprint or solver to work around missing validated assets.
